keyPoints.en: Present simple: facts and habits (She walks). Third person singular adds -s.
keyPoints.bm: Present simple: fakta dan tabiat (She walks). Orang ketiga tunggal ditambah -s.

keyPoints.en: Present continuous: actions now or temporary (She is walking).
keyPoints.bm: Present continuous: tindakan sekarang atau sementara (She is walking).

keyPoints.en: Present perfect: have/has + V3; signal words since, for, already, yet, ever, just.
keyPoints.bm: Present perfect: have/has + V3; kata petunjuk since, for, already, yet, ever, just.

tip.en: If you see a finished time (yesterday, last week, in 2020) → never present perfect.
tip.bm: Jika ada masa yang telah tamat (yesterday, last week, in 2020) → jangan gunakan present perfect.

keyPoints.bm: Past simple: tindakan yang telah tamat (V2).

keyPoints.en: Past continuous: action in progress, often interrupted (was/were + V-ing … when + past simple).
keyPoints.bm: Past continuous: tindakan sedang berlaku, sering diganggu (was/were + V-ing … when + past simple).

keyPoints.en: Past perfect: the earlier of two past actions (had + V3).
keyPoints.bm: Past perfect: tindakan lebih awal antara dua tindakan lampau (had + V3).

keyPoints.en: will: instant decisions, promises; going to: plans and evidence-based predictions; present continuous: arrangements.
keyPoints.bm: will: keputusan serta-merta, janji; going to: rancangan dan ramalan berbukti; present continuous: rancangan yang diatur.

keyPoints.en: each, every, one of, everyone → singular verb.
keyPoints.bm: each, every, one of, everyone → kata kerja tunggal.

keyPoints.en: neither…nor / either…or → agree with the nearer subject.
keyPoints.bm: neither…nor / either…or → sepadan dengan subjek terdekat.
